'''Beacon''' is a tiered {{Rare}}-{{Epic}} block that grants special buffs to players and minions on the island. The recipe for the first tier is unlocked at {{Coll|Mithril IX}}; subsequent tiers can be obtained from [[The Forge]] at higher [[Heart of the Mountain]] levels. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Mithril IX}} |A1 = Glass |B1 = Glass |C1 = Glass |A2 = Glass |B2 = Starfall, 64 |C2 = Glass |A3 = Enchanted Mithril, 64 |B3 = Enchanted Mithril, 64 |C3 = Enchanted Mithril, 64 |Output = Beacon I }} }} === [[The Forge|Forging]] === {| class="wikitable" ! Beacon V | class="ct" | {{Coll|HotM 5}} | {{DRL|/Beacon V/}} |} == Interface == {{/UI}} == Usage == Only {{Green|1}} '''Beacon''' can be placed on a Private Island. In order to power the '''Beacon''' the player must fuel it with {{Item|Power Crystal}}s or {{Item|Scorched Power Crystal}}s, granting {{Green|48 hours}} of power per crystal. Breaking a '''Beacon''' will cause any fuel to be lost. There is no maximum amount of time that the '''Beacon''' can be fueled for at once, other than the [[w:Java_syntax#Primitive_types|64-bit integer]] limit of {{Abbr|2.923e8 years|9,223,372,036,854,775,807 milliseconds}}. The '''Beacon''' gives a chosen stat to the player on all different SkyBlock Islands. Using a {{Item|Scorched Power Crystal}} increases the given stat boost by {{Green|+20%}}.
